avoid_supplements.name: High-dose chromium
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate hypoglycemic effects and increase risk of severe hypoglycemia
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid supplemental chromium; monitor blood glucose closely if concurrent use unavoidable

caution_supplements.name: Alpha-lipoic acid
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose regularly; patient education on hypoglycemia symptoms advised

caution_supplements.name: Cinnamon extract
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for signs of hypoglycemia; coordinate with healthcare provider

caution_supplements.name: Berberine
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose; educate on hypoglycemia awareness

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals (>50g fat per meal)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Delays gastric emptying and may exacerbate nausea/GI side effects; tirzepatide already slows gastric motility
avoid_foods.action: Counsel patients to consume low-fat, moderate-portion meals; space meals consistently

caution_foods.name: Rapid-digesting carbohydrates (high glycemic index)
caution_foods.mechanism: May cause postprandial blood glucose spikes; tirzepatide efficacy depends on meal composition adherence
caution_foods.action: Educate on balanced macronutrient intake and low-glycemic index food selection

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (particularly on empty stomach)
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase hypoglycemia risk and gastric irritation; tirzepatide delays gastric emptying
caution_foods.action: Advise moderate consumption with food; monitor for hypoglycemia symptoms

monitoring_notes: Tirzepatide has minimal hepatic metabolism and few drug interactions, but gastrointestinal tolerability is paramount—counsel on meal timing, composition, and portion control. Monitor for pancreatitis signs, hypoglycemia (especially if combined with other antidiabetics), and dehydration due to GI effects.
